enchantments.tooltip: Spellcasting Implement +30: Passive: +30 Implement bonus to Universal Spell Power.
+15 Enhancement Bonus: +15 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Sovereign Lightning Strike: This item crackles with power, flickers of lightning emanating from it. On a strike of a Natural 20 that is confirmed as a critical hit, this item will strike your foe with a tremendous burst of lightning. A DC 100 Reflex save will prevent half of this damage.
Shocking Blast 6: This weapon arcs with deadly electricity, dealing 6d6 Electric damage on a successful hit, and an additional 6d6 Electric damage on a critical hit.
Screeching 15: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to pulse with sound, dealing 15d6 Sonic damage on each critical hit.
Thunderstorm Lore +22: Passive: Your Sonic and Lightning spells gain a 22% Equipment bonus to their chance to critical hit.
Power of the Thunderstorm +151: Passive: +151 Equipment bonus to Sonic and Electric Spell Power.
